title: Compliance Operations
summary: Check a normalized control register for missing framework mappings, failed control tests, and stale evidence; prepare owner actions with provenance.

inputs.label: Control tests and evidence register
inputs.description: Approved normalized export with source identifiers and recorded values for each check. Dates and business thresholds are supplied by the responsible owner.

connections.name: Approved GRC evidence and framework register
prerequisites: Control owner has reviewed the framework mapping and test-result vocabulary.
An authorized reviewer supplies evidence validity dates and assessed regulatory changes; no legal deadline is inferred.
Named workspace owner, approved record scope, and evidence retention period.
Supply an approved structured export. This starter does not connect to or fetch from the source system.

sample_goal: Identify the failed access-review test and expired evidence, and the control missing its approved framework mapping.
deliverable: Cited control-evidence register, findings, and owner action list
acceptance: Every finding identifies the control row, source, failed check, and proposed owner action.
The sample flags C2 for failed testing and stale evidence and C3 for missing framework mapping; C1 passes.
A passed structured check is not an attestation, independent audit opinion, or verification of source authenticity.
stop_conditions: Escalate disputed framework applicability, conflicting test results, and regulatory interpretations to the compliance owner.
Stop if source provenance, workspace ownership, or an applicable numeric/date value cannot be verified.

rules.title: Approved framework mapping present
rules.action: Ask the control owner to supply and review the applicable framework clause.

rules.title: Recorded control test passed
rules.action: Prepare a remediation item for the control owner with the recorded failed test.

rules.title: Evidence remains within its approved validity date
rules.action: Request replacement evidence and preserve the superseded source reference.

title: Vendor Assurance
summary: Review supplier document completeness, recorded contract review, and insurance expiry from an approved vendor register.

inputs.label: Supplier assurance register
inputs.description: Approved normalized export with source identifiers and recorded values for each check. Dates and business thresholds are supplied by the responsible owner.

connections.name: Approved supplier onboarding and contract exports
prerequisites: Supplier identities and applicable document requirements are confirmed by procurement.
Contract-review decisions and insurance dates are supplied by authorized reviewers; no bank details are needed.
Named workspace owner, approved record scope, and evidence retention period.
Supply an approved structured export. This starter does not connect to or fetch from the source system.

sample_goal: Prepare exceptions for V2 missing its tax document and approaching insurance expiry, and V3 awaiting contract review.
deliverable: Evidence-backed supplier review and exception follow-up packet
acceptance: Preserve supplier, source, and missing requirement for each exception.
The sample finds two issues for V2 and the contract-review issue for V3; V1 passes.
A complete row does not activate a supplier or prove coverage is sufficient.
stop_conditions: Escalate identity, banking, sanctions, coverage interpretation, or contract-signature questions to an authorized owner.
Stop if source provenance, workspace ownership, or an applicable numeric/date value cannot be verified.

rules.title: Required tax document reference present
rules.action: Ask procurement to obtain the missing approved tax-document reference.

rules.title: Contract review recorded as approved
rules.action: Route the contract issue to counsel; keep supplier activation pending.

rules.title: Insurance expires within 30 days
rules.action: Prepare an insurance renewal request for the procurement owner to review.

title: AP & Purchasing Exceptions
summary: Compare normalized invoice, purchase-order and receipt values, then identify missing acknowledgements and overdue receiving follow-ups.

inputs.label: Invoice, PO, and receipt reconciliation rows
inputs.description: Approved normalized export with source identifiers and recorded values for each check. Dates and business thresholds are supplied by the responsible owner.

connections.name: Approved purchasing and payable exports
prerequisites: Join invoice, PO, and receipt lines using reviewed business keys before upload.
Amounts must share currency and tax basis; quantities must share units. Preserve all source identifiers in the source field or cited export.
Named workspace owner, approved record scope, and evidence retention period.
Supply an approved structured export. This starter does not connect to or fetch from the source system.

sample_goal: Find P2 amount and quantity mismatches, missing supplier acknowledgement, and its overdue receipt date.
deliverable: Three-way match exception worklist and proposed PO follow-up packet
acceptance: Report numeric comparison failures separately from missing acknowledgement and overdue receiving.
The sample produces four P2 findings; P1 and P3 pass.
The worklist never releases, stages, or transmits a payment.
stop_conditions: Stop on mixed currencies, mixed units, ambiguous line joins, disputed receipts, or unverified payment instructions.
Stop if source provenance, workspace ownership, or an applicable numeric/date value cannot be verified.

rules.title: Invoice amount equals approved PO amount
rules.action: Ask the buyer to reconcile pricing, tax basis, and authorized PO changes.

rules.title: Invoiced quantity does not exceed received quantity
rules.action: Request receiving evidence or an authorized hold decision from AP.

rules.title: Supplier acknowledgement reference present
rules.action: Prepare an acknowledgement follow-up for the buyer to review.

rules.title: Receipt due date has passed
rules.action: Ask the buyer to review delivery status and prepare a supplier follow-up.

title: Support Operations
summary: Check ticket routing, approved answer references, and response deadlines; prepare routing and knowledge-gap work for support review.

inputs.label: Support ticket routing and knowledge-reference export
inputs.description: Approved normalized export with source identifiers and recorded values for each check. Dates and business thresholds are supplied by the responsible owner.

connections.name: Approved support queue and knowledge-base exports
prerequisites: Remove unnecessary personal data from ticket excerpts.
Support owner supplies response deadlines and approved answer references; no entitlement or priority is inferred from protected attributes.
Named workspace owner, approved record scope, and evidence retention period.
Supply an approved structured export. This starter does not connect to or fetch from the source system.

sample_goal: Identify S2 as unassigned, lacking an approved answer, and past its response deadline; preserve its ticket topic for follow-up.
deliverable: Ticket routing exceptions, response preparation, and knowledge-gap worklist
acceptance: Each exception retains ticket topic and source so the support lead can inspect related cases.
The sample produces three findings for S2; closed S3 is not flagged for its old response deadline.
Knowledge-gap rows propose work; they are not automatically published knowledge articles or customer replies.
stop_conditions: Escalate security incidents, threats, disputed entitlements, or unapproved advice to the named owner.
Stop if source provenance, workspace ownership, or an applicable numeric/date value cannot be verified.
blocked_actions: Close or reroute tickets in a live system

rules.title: Assigned support queue present
rules.action: Prepare a routing proposal for the support queue owner.

rules.title: Approved answer reference present
rules.action: Ask the knowledge owner to prepare or approve an answer for this topic.

rules.title: Unresolved ticket response is due
rules.action: Flag the response obligation for the support lead and prepare a reviewed reply.

title: Security Questionnaire Desk
summary: Match structured questionnaire answers to approved answer and evidence references, and flag expired answer reviews before a response package is released.

inputs.label: Questionnaire response and evidence register
inputs.description: Approved normalized export with source identifiers and recorded values for each check. Dates and business thresholds are supplied by the responsible owner.

connections.name: Approved security answer library and questionnaire export
prerequisites: Security owner supplies question identifiers, approved response text, and evidence references.
Approved-answer reuse scope and review expiry must cover this customer and questionnaire version.
Named workspace owner, approved record scope, and evidence retention period.
Supply an approved structured export. This starter does not connect to or fetch from the source system.

sample_goal: Prepare the unanswered Q2 escalation and Q3 expired-review exception while preserving Q1 as a supported answer.
deliverable: Questionnaire response register with unsupported-answer and review-expiry exceptions
acceptance: Every populated answer remains attributable to its provided evidence reference.
The sample flags missing answer and evidence for Q2 and expired review for Q3.
The starter checks provided fields and dates; a person still verifies semantic relevance, confidentiality, and truthful commitments.
stop_conditions: Stop when a question needs a new commitment, evidence disclosure permission, legal interpretation, or an answer outside the approved library.
Stop if source provenance, workspace ownership, or an applicable numeric/date value cannot be verified.

rules.title: Approved response text present
rules.action: Escalate the unanswered question to the security assurance owner.

rules.title: Supporting evidence reference present
rules.action: Request an approved evidence reference before releasing the answer.

rules.title: Answer review is expired
rules.action: Have the answer owner review current control evidence and renew the answer approval.

records.question: Are access reviews performed?
records.approved_answer: The supplied policy schedules quarterly access reviews.

records.question: How often are recovery exercises held?
records.approved_answer: The supplied plan schedules an annual recovery exercise.

title: Privacy Operations
summary: Organize a minimized privacy-request register, record identity-review prerequisites, and flag missing search evidence and owner-supplied response deadlines.

inputs.label: Privacy request readiness register
inputs.description: Approved normalized export with source identifiers and recorded values for each check. Dates and business thresholds are supplied by the responsible owner.

connections.name: Approved privacy case and record-search exports
prerequisites: Use pseudonymous request identifiers and minimized metadata rather than identity documents or requested personal records.
An authorized privacy reviewer determines jurisdiction, identity status, exemptions, holds, and response due dates.
Named workspace owner, approved record scope, and evidence retention period.
Supply an approved structured export. This starter does not connect to or fetch from the source system.

sample_goal: Flag D2 identity review, missing search evidence, and its response due within seven days; do not reopen closed D3.
deliverable: Privacy response preparation worklist with evidence and deadline exceptions
acceptance: Separate identity-review, search-evidence, and response-deadline exceptions.
The sample produces three D2 findings; closed D3 is excluded from deadline escalation.
Identity, disclosure, deletion, legal holds, and legal deadline calculation are outside this deterministic check.
stop_conditions: Stop on unverified identity, legal holds, disputed scope, exemptions, or third-party personal data requiring privacy counsel review.
Stop if source provenance, workspace ownership, or an applicable numeric/date value cannot be verified.

rules.title: Authorized identity review recorded as verified
rules.action: Keep fulfillment pending and request the authorized privacy identity-review result.

rules.title: Scoped record-search reference present
rules.action: Request the approved record-search inventory reference from the data owner.

rules.title: Open privacy response is due within seven days
rules.action: Prepare the response review packet and escalate the owner-supplied due date.

title: Contract Obligations & Renewals
summary: Review a human-extracted obligation register for ownership, clause provenance, and upcoming notice deadlines; prepare action packets.

inputs.label: Reviewed contract obligation and notice register
inputs.description: Approved normalized export with source identifiers and recorded values for each check. Dates and business thresholds are supplied by the responsible owner.

connections.name: Approved contract register and extracted clause references
prerequisites: Counsel or the contract owner verifies extracted clauses, triggering events, notice method, and computed deadlines.
Include only contracts within the workspace scope; review privilege or confidentiality restrictions before upload.
Named workspace owner, approved record scope, and evidence retention period.
Supply an approved structured export. This starter does not connect to or fetch from the source system.

sample_goal: Find O2 missing its owner and approaching notice deadline, and O3 lacking its clause citation.
deliverable: Contract obligation and renewal action packets with clause provenance
acceptance: Every exception identifies the obligation and the precise missing input or upcoming notice date.
The sample flags owner and notice issues for O2 and missing clause provenance for O3; O1 passes.
Dates are reviewed inputs, not independently calculated legal notice deadlines.
stop_conditions: Escalate ambiguous clauses, amendments, triggering events, notice requirements, or disputed obligations to counsel.
Stop if source provenance, workspace ownership, or an applicable numeric/date value cannot be verified.

rules.title: Named obligation owner present
rules.action: Ask the contracts manager to assign the accountable business owner.

rules.title: Reviewed clause reference present
rules.action: Request the verified contract version and clause reference.

rules.title: Open obligation notice is due within 30 days
rules.action: Prepare an action packet for the owner and counsel before the notice deadline.

title: Audit Readiness
summary: Check prepared-by-client evidence for missing references, recorded owner confirmation, and evidence validity dates before an auditor package is reviewed.

inputs.label: Prepared-by-client evidence index
inputs.description: Approved normalized export with source identifiers and recorded values for each check. Dates and business thresholds are supplied by the responsible owner.

connections.name: Approved audit request and evidence exports
prerequisites: Audit scope, reporting period, request identifiers, and evidence validity criteria are confirmed by the audit lead.
Evidence owners approve access and sharing scope; source records remain in their approved repository.
Named workspace owner, approved record scope, and evidence retention period.
Supply an approved structured export. This starter does not connect to or fetch from the source system.

sample_goal: Find A2 missing evidence and owner confirmation with expired validity, and A3 with expired evidence validity.
deliverable: Auditor-package provenance index and missing or stale evidence worklist
acceptance: Each requested item keeps its source, owner-review status, and evidence-validity date.
The sample produces three A2 findings and one A3 freshness finding; A1 passes.
Package readiness does not establish audit sufficiency or authorize delivery to an auditor.
stop_conditions: Stop on mismatched audit periods, restricted evidence, inconsistent versions, or disputed owner confirmation.
Stop if source provenance, workspace ownership, or an applicable numeric/date value cannot be verified.

rules.title: Requested evidence reference present
rules.action: Ask the assigned evidence owner to provide the approved artifact reference.

rules.title: Evidence owner confirmation recorded
rules.action: Prepare the item for explicit evidence-owner review.

rules.title: Evidence validity has expired
rules.action: Request current evidence matching the audit reporting period.

title: Employee Onboarding & Offboarding
summary: Reconcile cross-functional lifecycle checklist status with completion references and due dates, preparing verified-completion gaps for HR and IT.

inputs.label: Minimized employee lifecycle checklist
inputs.description: Approved normalized export with source identifiers and recorded values for each check. Dates and business thresholds are supplied by the responsible owner.

connections.name: Approved HR and IT checklist exports
prerequisites: Use internal pseudonymous case references; omit protected characteristics and unnecessary personal data.
HR authorizes the lifecycle case; IT and payroll remain responsible for their controlled actions and completion evidence.
Named workspace owner, approved record scope, and evidence retention period.
Supply an approved structured export. This starter does not connect to or fetch from the source system.

sample_goal: Flag L2 pending offboarding access review, absent completion evidence, and an overdue checklist step.
deliverable: Onboarding and offboarding completion checklist with owner handoffs
acceptance: Separate recorded completion state from supporting completion evidence.
The sample finds all three L2 gaps; the completed L1 and L3 steps pass.
This report neither changes access nor makes employment, payroll, or disciplinary decisions.
stop_conditions: Stop on disputed HR authorization, mismatched employee identity, access authority, or missing completion evidence.
Stop if source provenance, workspace ownership, or an applicable numeric/date value cannot be verified.

rules.title: Checklist step is recorded complete
rules.action: Ask the responsible HR or IT owner to review and complete the authorized checklist step.

rules.title: Completion reference present
rules.action: Request a verification receipt from the system owner before marking completion.

rules.title: Incomplete checklist step is overdue
rules.action: Escalate the overdue step to the lifecycle case owner.

title: Revenue Operations
summary: Check opportunity exports for duplicate business identifiers, missing next steps, and inactivity beyond owner-approved thresholds.

inputs.label: Opportunity hygiene and activity register
inputs.description: Approved normalized export with source identifiers and recorded values for each check. Dates and business thresholds are supplied by the responsible owner.

connections.name: Approved CRM opportunity export
prerequisites: Opportunity identifiers, activity-age calculations, and allowable inactivity thresholds are reviewed by revenue operations.
Provide account summaries without sensitive contact data unless expressly approved for the workspace.
Named workspace owner, approved record scope, and evidence retention period.
Supply an approved structured export. This starter does not connect to or fetch from the source system.

sample_goal: Find R2 missing its next step, R2 and R3 sharing one opportunity identifier, and R4 exceeding its activity threshold.
deliverable: CRM correction proposals and stalled-opportunity review packet
acceptance: Flag all members of a duplicate identifier group without choosing a record to delete or merge.
The sample reports R2 next-step, R2/R3 duplicate, and R4 inactivity findings; R1 passes.
Suggested follow-up work remains a draft for the account owner.
stop_conditions: Stop before choosing a merge survivor, changing deal value or stage, or using ambiguous identity matches.
Stop if source provenance, workspace ownership, or an applicable numeric/date value cannot be verified.

rules.title: Opportunity next step present
rules.action: Ask the account owner to provide a dated next step and supporting context.

rules.title: Opportunity identifier is unique
rules.action: Prepare a duplicate review for revenue operations; preserve both records.

rules.title: Activity age stays within approved threshold
rules.action: Prepare a stalled-opportunity brief for the account owner.

title: Billing & Collections Preparation
summary: Compare invoices with reviewed contract charges, flag unreconciled items and past-due balances, and prepare collection or dispute follow-up work.

inputs.label: Invoice, contract-charge, and payment-status register
inputs.description: Approved normalized export with source identifiers and recorded values for each check. Dates and business thresholds are supplied by the responsible owner.

connections.name: Approved billing, contract, and receivables exports
prerequisites: Normalize contract and invoice amounts to the same currency, tax basis, service period, and approved adjustments.
Finance provides current payment status and contractual due dates; disputed items remain with the authorized billing reviewer.
Named workspace owner, approved record scope, and evidence retention period.
Supply an approved structured export. This starter does not connect to or fetch from the source system.

sample_goal: Identify B2 amount mismatch, unreconciled status, and overdue balance for a billing-owner review.
deliverable: Invoice reconciliation, aging exceptions, and draft collection follow-up packet
acceptance: Preserve invoice, contract amount, payment status, and source in the review packet.
The sample produces three B2 findings; B1 and B3 pass.
A past-due finding proposes review, never collection escalation, fees, credit decisions, or money movement.
stop_conditions: Stop on disputed debt, unclear adjustments, mixed currency, settlement ambiguity, or uncertain customer identity.
Stop if source provenance, workspace ownership, or an applicable numeric/date value cannot be verified.

rules.title: Invoice agrees with reviewed contract charge
rules.action: Prepare the invoice and contract-charge variance for billing review.

rules.title: Billing reconciliation is complete
rules.action: Assign unresolved reconciliation to the billing owner before external follow-up.

rules.title: Unsettled invoice is past due
rules.action: Prepare a balance-confirmation and follow-up draft for finance review.

title: Software Release Operations
summary: Review supplied release evidence for required test results, rollback references, and unresolved blockers; prepare release-owner decisions.

inputs.label: Release candidate readiness evidence
inputs.description: Approved normalized export with source identifiers and recorded values for each check. Dates and business thresholds are supplied by the responsible owner.

connections.name: Approved release, test, and change-management exports
prerequisites: Bind test evidence, issues, and rollback plan to an immutable candidate revision.
The release owner defines required test outcomes and blocker thresholds; live CI and deployment access are not used by this starter.
Named workspace owner, approved record scope, and evidence retention period.
Supply an approved structured export. This starter does not connect to or fetch from the source system.

sample_goal: Flag REL2 failed tests, missing rollback evidence, and three blockers exceeding the permitted zero.
deliverable: Release evidence register, unresolved-issue worklist, and release-note preparation packet
acceptance: Each candidate retains its revision and evidence source in the review packet.
The sample produces three REL2 findings; REL1 and REL3 pass.
Passing checks do not approve a release or deploy a build.
stop_conditions: Stop on missing immutable revision, mismatched test revision, unreviewed rollback plan, or uncertain incident status.
Stop if source provenance, workspace ownership, or an applicable numeric/date value cannot be verified.

rules.title: Required test outcome is passed
rules.action: Request a release-owner decision on recorded test failures and retest evidence.

rules.title: Reviewed rollback plan reference present
rules.action: Ask the release owner to provide a candidate-specific reviewed rollback plan.

rules.title: Open blockers remain within the approved limit
rules.action: Prepare the unresolved blocker list for release review.

title: Management Reporting
summary: Reconcile reported operating metrics to source values, identify missing owners and overdue reviews, and prepare decisions for management.

inputs.label: Operating metric and review register
inputs.description: Approved normalized export with source identifiers and recorded values for each check. Dates and business thresholds are supplied by the responsible owner.

connections.name: Approved management reporting and metric-source exports
prerequisites: Metric owners verify definitions, period boundaries, units, and source values before upload.
Decision requests and review dates come from an approved operating cadence; publication recipients require separate review.
Named workspace owner, approved record scope, and evidence retention period.
Supply an approved structured export. This starter does not connect to or fetch from the source system.

sample_goal: Find M2 lacking an accountable metric owner, disagreeing with its source, and awaiting an overdue review.
deliverable: Source-linked operating brief and management decisions-needed worklist
acceptance: Report metric value differences with both supplied values and source identifiers.
The sample produces three M2 findings; M1 and M3 pass.
The report preserves source provenance and requires management review before distribution.
stop_conditions: Stop on inconsistent reporting periods, definitions, currencies, restricted board material, or unverified figures.
Stop if source provenance, workspace ownership, or an applicable numeric/date value cannot be verified.

rules.title: Metric owner present
rules.action: Ask the chief of staff to identify the accountable metric owner.

rules.title: Reported value matches the source value
rules.action: Prepare the variance and both cited values for metric-owner reconciliation.

rules.title: Unconfirmed metric review is overdue
rules.action: Escalate the review and decision needed to the operating meeting owner.
